newsitem.title: USA: Noel says founder Marx resigned from board.
newsitem.headline: Noel says founder Marx resigned from board.

text.p: Noel Group Inc said on Friday founder, Louis Marx Jr, and two of directors, Thomas Israel and John MacDonald, have resigned from the board.
The board reduction, from 14 to 11 members, was made in anticipation of no further Noel investment activities pending shareholders' adoption of a liquidation plan, which the board recommended in May.
The company plans to hold a shareholder meeting to approve the Plan of Complete Liquidation and Dissolution in the Fall.
Upon shareholder approval of the plan, Noel expects to commence the liquidation of its assets,
Noel does not expect to make distributions prior to the formal adoption of the liquidation plan by shareholders.
